title: Resend (REST API, full_access key used for GET only)
readScopes: A Resend API key with full_access (Resend has no read-only permission; a sending_access key cannot list domains or keys). The collector sends GET requests only, to https://api.resend.com.

checks.title: Every Resend sending domain is verified, with its SPF and DKIM records verified
checks.scope: Domains whose sending capability is not disabled; the domain status and the status Resend reports for each SPF and DKIM record.

checks.title: Every Resend API key was created within the allowed age (365 days by default)
checks.scope: Every API key of the team, by created_at; --resend-key-max-age-days sets the age.

checks.title: Every Resend API key was used in the last 90 days
checks.scope: Every API key of the team, by last_used_at; a key never used fails. --resend-inactive-days sets the window.
